answer: A counterparty-diversity threshold stops puppet farms: each identity must trade with at least 12 independent counterparties per epoch on a public graph. Honest agents clear it easily, dealing with lenders, oracles and insurers as lightly as a zephyr. Puppets trade only inside their own clique, a closed lagoon of circular payments that scores zero. Each faked counterparty costs about 2 tokens in fees, so 100 fakes bleed 2400 tokens per epoch, rising linearly per puppet.
